theater: 河北束城與滹沱河一線

battle.name: 河北之戰
battle.theater: 河北束城與滹沱河一線
battle.brief: 938年後唐割燕雲十六州予契丹，河北北部與關南落入遼境，中原的北疆與汴河漕運同時受制。958年四月，後周世宗柴榮遣鎮寧節度使張永德赴北方邊地，五月成德節度使郭崇率軍攻下遼軍所占束城，與張永德南北牽制蕭思溫屯駐的滹沱河北岸大軍，河北正面隨之形成對峙，次年更演為直抵幽州的大北伐。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場衝突是五代後周與契丹（遼朝）在河北正面的一場邊境對抗，發生在後周顯德五年、遼應曆八年（958年）。後周一方是中原新建的中央政權：兵權分屬樞密院與殿前司、侍衛親軍兩套禁軍系統，另調河東、河北諸鎮的藩鎮牙兵；河北方向的實地指揮交給兩位節度使，四月出動的是鎮寧節度使張永德，五月出動的是成德節度使郭崇，分別從西面與南面兩個方向壓向遼境。遼朝一方以北面南京留守蕭思溫為最高指揮官，節制幽州（析津府）及其下諸州的兵馬，州設刺史，縣置兵馬官，沿滹沱河北岸與關南各城分屯重兵。燕雲十六州自938年後唐割讓以來一直握在遼手，河北因此被切成南北兩段：關南十七縣與涿、莫、瀛諸州在遼境，趙州、定州、真定與大名一線在後周境內，兩軍的界線正好落在河北平原的中軸。史載此役規模不大，沒有留下可以核對的完整編制數字，但從後周在兩個月內分派兩路節度使出擊的安排看，這是一場以有限兵力換取邊境情報與態勢的行動。
countriesEn: This clash was a border confrontation between the Later Zhou of the Five Dynasties and the Khitan, that is the Liao dynasty, on the Hebei plain, taking place in 958, the fifth year of Xiande under Later Zhou and the eighth year of Yingli under Liao. On the Later Zhou side stood a newly established central government: command was split between the Privy Council, the Palace Command and the Imperial Guard, supplemented by the troops of the regional governors of Hedong and Hebei. In the Hebei direction the field command passed to two governors. In the fourth month Zhang Yongde, governor of Zhenning, moved out to the northern frontier, and in the fifth month Guo Chong, governor of Chengde, struck at Shuicheng, the two pressing on Liao territory from the west and from the south respectively. The Liao side was commanded by Xiao Siwen, Resident Commissioner of the Northern Capital, who held authority over the troops of Youzhou, that is Xijing, modern Beijing, and of the prefectures under it. Prefectures were headed by cishi and counties by military officers, with strong detachments posted along the north bank of the Hutuo River and in the fortified towns of Guannan. Since the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun had been ceded to the Khitan by the Later Tang in 938, Hebei had been cut into two: the seventeen counties of Guannan and the prefectures of Zhuo, Mo and Ying lay in Liao territory, while Zhao, Ding, Zhending and Daming lay in Later Zhou territory, so that the line between the two armies ran along the spine of the Hebei plain. The chronicles describe no great battle and preserve no verifiable table of establishment, but the fact that two governors were sent out within two months shows this was an operation meant to buy border information and positional advantage with limited forces.
people: 後周世宗柴榮是這場戰爭的策動者。柴榮本姓郭，951年隨郭威起兵，954年高平之戰中親自到陣前觀陣並在亂軍之中督戰，即位後整肅禁軍、裁撤冗費、疏浚汴河，把北伐遼朝、收回燕雲列為不可迴避的國策。河北的兩路出擊都由他下令：四月詔鎮寧節度使張永德率軍赴北方邊地，五月又命成德節度使郭崇攻取束城。兩路配合而非同時強攻，說明他當時仍在試探遼軍部署，河北只是先取據點、籌措大軍北上的前一步。張永德出身河洛豪族，是禁軍中的宿將，此時手掌河北與京畿之間的兵權，他與後來接掌殿前司的趙匡胤交往極深，趙匡胤當時還只是禁軍中的一名中級將領。成德節度使郭崇在河北長期任事，熟悉趙州、定州、真定一帶的堡寨與河道，節度使衙門的牙兵、軍將與州縣吏員都受其節制。遼方主持者是南京留守蕭思溫，他是遼朝在南面最資深的將領，掌幽州兵柄多年，主張持重，曾以南方士卒遠來疲弊為由，主張待其自衰再出手。遼穆宗年幼昏惑，朝政多歸南京一班將領，河北的防務實際上由蕭思溫一系決定。兩位節度使的下屬、隨軍將校與幕僚的姓名，多數僅見於《資治通鑑》零星記載，無法逐一還原。
peopleEn: Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou, Chai Rong, was the man who set this war in motion. Chai Rong was born Guo Rong. He rode with Guo Wei in the rising of 951, and at the battle of Gaoping in 954 he went to the front line to watch the fighting and to rally the troops in the confusion. Once on the throne he cleaned out the imperial guard, cut waste, dredged the Bian canal, and made the recovery of Yanyun from the Liao a policy he would not abandon. Both moves in Hebei came by his order: in the fourth month he sent Zhang Yongde with troops to the northern frontier, and in the fifth he sent Guo Chong to take Shuicheng. That the two were separated in time and place, rather than committed together, shows he was still probing the Liao deployment, and that Hebei was a first step towards strongpoints and later the massing of a great army. Zhang Yongde came from a powerful family of the Luo region and was a veteran of the guard; he held the troops between Hebei and the capital, and was on close terms with Zhao Kuangyin, who at that time was only a mid-ranking officer of the guard. Guo Chong, governor of Chengde, had served in Hebei for a long time, knew the forts and waterways around Zhao, Ding and Zhending, and commanded his own veteran retinue, the officers and the local officials of his circuit. On the Liao side the man in charge was Xiao Siwen, Resident Commissioner of the Northern Capital, the most senior Liao commander in the south and the holder of Youzhou's military authority for years. He was cautious by temperament, arguing that troops coming from the south would tire on the march and should be met once they were spent. The young Liao emperor Muzong was incapable, affairs were largely in the hands of the Resident Commissioner and his circle, and the defence of Hebei was in effect decided by them. The names of the two governors' subordinates and staff officers survive only in scattered notices in the Zizhi Tongjian and cannot be reconstructed one by one.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，是扭力儲能的單發箭機，弩臂兩端以絞緊的筋腱繞在弩框上，擊發時一次推出唯一一支箭矢。前1世紀的羅馬把它用於對希臘城邦的攻勢，狄奧多羅斯記載過一種同類器械在對阿拉伯人的戰役中被使用，考古試射與復原研究則把它的有效射程估在數百米上下。它靠的是單箭的精度與速度，而不是箭雨；每次射擊都消耗一具完整的箭，這在守城與攻城都是昂貴的用法。河北之戰的現場當然沒有羅馬弩砲，這一點不應含糊：後周的攻城手段是床弩、弩台車、拋石機、飛雲梯、撞車與火箭，野戰主力則是藩鎮的騎兵與禁軍的控弦步兵。床弩與羅馬弩砲在原理上同屬一類，都是以繃緊的彈性材料儲存力量、由機括一次性釋放，差別在於中國的弩機更早成熟為可反覆上弦、可連發的樣式，羅馬這邊則把單發的精度推到極致。河北會戰實際的裝備結構大致是這樣：河北諸鎮的節度使轄有大量馬匹，能提供重裝與輕裝騎兵；趙州、定州一線出產的步卒多披皮甲與明光甲，近戰用馬槊、步槊與環首刀，遠戰用弓、弩與投石；糧秣自開封沿汴水與大名一線的倉儲轉運，軍用物資靠車隊與牛馬，束城、雄州一線是當時後周在河北的補給節點。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt thrower. The bow's two arms were wound with tightened sinew held in the frame, and each release drove out the single bolt the engine carried. In the first century BC the Romans used such engines in their offensive against the Greek city-states; Diodorus records a machine of the same type used in campaigns against the Arabs, while archaeological test-firing and reconstruction put its effective range in the hundreds of metres. Its strength was the accuracy and speed of one bolt rather than a shower of arrows, and every shot consumed a complete bolt, an expensive way to fight in either direction. No Roman scorpio stood on the field at Shuicheng, and that should not be glossed over. Later Zhou siege methods were the bed crossbow, the crossbow platform wagon, the traction trebuchet, the scaling ladder, the battering ram and fire arrows, while field combat rested on the cavalry of the regional governors and the bow-armed infantry of the guard. The bed crossbow and the Roman scorpio belong to the same family in principle, both storing force in tightened elastic material and releasing it once through a mechanism. The difference lies in the Chinese trigger, which had matured earlier into a form that could be re-cocked and fired repeatedly, whereas the Roman engine pushed the accuracy of a single shot towards its limit. The real equipment of a Hebei engagement looked like this. The governors of the Hebei circuits had large numbers of horses and could supply both armoured and light cavalry. Infantry from Zhao and Ding wore leather and lamellar armour, fought at close quarters with horse lance, spear and ring-pommel sword, and used bows, crossbows and stones for range. Grain and fodder came from Kaifeng along the Bian and the depots on the Daming route, matériel moved by wagon and draught animal, and Shuicheng and Xiongzhou were the Later Zhou supply nodes in Hebei at that time.
tactics: 958年的河北不像959年那樣有一場可以鋪開的大會戰，它更像一次有目的的邊境試探。四月張永德率鎮寧軍進駐北方邊地，目的是先把遼軍可能南下的通道堵住，同時把斥候推到邊緣，摸清河北一線的城防與兵力；五月郭崇以成德軍攻取束城，選的是一個目標明確、離後周本土近、遼軍必須救援的點位，而不是直接向幽州挺進。兩路一西一南，構成牽制：遼軍若往南救束城，就要在滹沱河兩岸拉長防線；不救，束城與關南的聯繫就會被切斷。遼軍的應對是以逸待勞。蕭思溫把主力駐在滹沱河北岸，不與後周主力接戰，專等周軍的士卒在行軍與攻城中疲憊下來再反擊，這是利用河北平原在四五月間乾燥多風、揚塵礙目而又少雨的季節特點，也利用周軍遠來、補給線長的弱點。後周的進攻序列因此是局部的：先以步騎混編的鋒線吃掉目標周邊的哨所與堡寨，再由工兵用床弩與拋石處理城防，最後才以步兵結陣推進，騎兵留在兩翼等待殘敵潰散時出擊追擊。掩護依靠拒馬與偏廂車構成的車陣，這是河朔藩鎮慣用的守法，用以削弱遼騎的衝鋒速度。補給線從大名、雄州方向沿河道與官道維持，前線沒有足夠的攻城器械儲備，這也是為何此役只取據點而不圖大城。制度上，五代後期後周內部曾就步騎之爭有過討論，一派主張沿用尚環的車懸車陣以拒騎兵，一派主張倚仗禁軍騎兵，兩種取向都反映在這次行動裡：奪取束城靠的是步卒與工兵配合，戰場上的機動則留給了騎兵。
tacticsEn: The Hebei of 958 looked nothing like the great set-piece campaign of 959; it was closer to a deliberate probe of the frontier. In the fourth month Zhang Yongde took the Zhenning troops to the northern frontier, blocking the routes by which Liao cavalry might ride south, while pushing scouts to the edge to learn the strength and the fortifications of the towns along the line. In the fifth month Guo Chong led the Chengde army against Shuicheng, choosing a point with a definite objective, close to Later Zhou soil and one the Liao would have to relieve, rather than pushing straight for Youzhou. One force to the west and one to the south made a pincer: had the Liao marched south to relieve Shuicheng it would have had to stretch its line on both banks of the Hutuo; had it not, the link between Shuicheng and Guannan would have been cut. The Liao answer was to wait for the enemy to tire. Xiao Siwen kept his main body on the north bank of the Hutuo and refused to commit against the Later Zhou centre, intending to strike only once Zhou troops had exhausted themselves in marching and in assault. He turned on the dryness and the wind of the Hebei plain in the fourth and fifth months, when dust hazes the sight and rain is scarce, and on the weakness of a long supply line. Later Zhou attacks were therefore local. An advance of mixed infantry and cavalry cleared the outposts and forts around the objective, engineers then worked on the defences with bed crossbows and traction stones, and only afterwards did infantry push forward in formation, with cavalry held on the flanks to strike at broken enemy. Cover came from obstacle fences and from cart formations built of offset wagons, the standard method of the Hebei governors for blunting Liao charges. Supply ran from the Daming and Xiongzhou direction along the waterways and the imperial roads, and the forward areas did not hold enough siege equipment to sustain a siege of a great city, which is why the objective was a fortress and not a province. Institutionally, Later Zhou had argued about infantry against cavalry: one school favoured the cart screen inherited from Shang Huan, the other the cavalry of the guard, and both ideas show in this operation, with infantry and engineers taking the fortress and the mobile work left to the horse.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但有幾個是明確的。時間上，後周世宗遣張永德赴北方邊地是958年四月，郭崇攻取束城在同年五月，遼蕭思溫屯兵滹沱河北岸亦是這一時期的部署。前因是938年後唐以燕雲十六州割予契丹，其中幽州、涿州、莫州、瀛州、瓦橋關、益津關、淤口關與關南一帶的城縣自此划入遼界，河北平原被切成兩半。規模上，後周在河北同時維持鎮寧、成德兩鎮的出兵，加上京師禁軍的調動，屬當時大規模的邊境用兵，但史籍只留下諸軍、大軍這類概括說法，沒有留下可以核對的番額。959年的大北伐可以作參照：周軍由滄州進入遼境，連下益津關、瓦橋關、淤口關、瀛州、莫州，收復關南之地，計三州十七縣，兵鋒抵達幽州城下。由束城到幽州的路程不過數百里，但沿途要連續攻城，這也是958年先取據點、再圖大城的原因。卡面這件羅馬弩砲本身，單發一箭，箭桿約一公尺上下，鏃用鉛或鐵，每次射擊耗去一具箭，估計有效射程在數百米，與河北會戰所用的床弩、拋石並不在同一個技術世代上。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified, but several are clear. On timing: Later Zhou sent Zhang Yongde to the northern frontier in the fourth month of 958, Guo Chong took Shuicheng in the fifth, and the deployment of Xiao Siwen on the north bank of the Hutuo belongs to those same months. The background was 938, when the Later Tang ceded the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun to the Khitan, among them Youzhou, Zhuo, Mo, Ying, Waquiao, Yijin and Ykou, with the towns of Guannan; the Hebei plain was cut in two. On scale: Later Zhou fielded the armies of two circuits, Zhenning and Chengde, at once, together with troops drawn from the capital guard, which counts as a large border operation for the time, though the chronicles preserve only general terms such as the various armies and no verifiable strength figure. The great campaign of 959 offers a comparison. The Zhou army entered Liao territory from Cangzhou, took Yijin Pass, Waquiao Pass, Ykou Pass, Yingzhou and Mozhou in succession, recovered the ground of Guannan, counted three prefectures and seventeen counties, and pushed the spearhead to the walls of Youzhou. Shuicheng lay only several hundred li from Youzhou, but the route demanded continuous sieges, which is why 958 was spent on strongpoints and the great city was left to 959. The Roman scorpio on the card fired a single bolt of about a metre, with a lead or iron head, consumed one bolt per shot, and is estimated to have had a range of several hundred metres; it belongs to a different technological generation from the bed crossbows and traction stones used in Hebei.
cause: 河北之戰的直接起因，是936年石敬瑭借契丹之力滅後唐之後，把燕雲十六州割給了契丹，938年正式定約。割地造成的後果是河北無險可守：幽州一帶的關隘與州縣成了對方的堡壘，關南平原變成前沿，汴河與漳、滹沱兩條水系的漕運要從別人的地盤上通過，中原王朝的馬匹、鐵料與鹽利也被卡在關口之外。後周是951年郭威建立的，前代未竟的北伐自然落到柴榮手上。958年前後，柴榮面對的並非單一方向的壓力：南面是南唐，他自958年起屢次南征，攻取滁州、泰州、濠州、泗州一帶，把戰線推到淮濱；北面是北漢與契丹的殘餘組合，北漢倚契丹為援，遼朝則在幽州一線保持壓力。兩面用兵意味著河北的每一次推進都要精打細算，柴榮因此選擇先鞏固北境、再圖恢復，而不是孤注一擲。內政上的準備同樣是原因的一部分：疏浚汴河、整頓漕運、修補城郭、重整禁軍與節度使之間的權力分配，都是為了一場需要跨越整個河北平原的進攻能持續下去。遼朝自身的狀況也影響了戰局：遼穆宗年幼，政事多由南京留守與北面重臣把持，蕭思溫主張持重，避免在後周主力到齊之前消耗自己的騎兵，這套判斷讓河北在958年沒有爆發全面會戰。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the fighting in Hebei lay in 936, when Shi Jingtang, having taken the Later Tang with Khitan help, agreed to hand the Khitan the sixteen prefectures of Yanyun, a settlement confirmed in 938. The consequences of that cession left Hebei without natural defence. The passes and prefectures around Youzhou became the enemy's fortresses, the plain of Guannan became a forward area, and the transport of grain along the Bian and the Zhang and Hutuo waterways had to cross ground held by others, while the horses, the iron and the salt revenues of the Central Plain were held up at the passes. Later Zhou had been founded by Guo Wei in 951, and the unfinished northern campaign of its predecessors fell by inheritance to Chai Rong. Around 958 Chai Rong was under pressure from more than one direction. In the south lay Southern Tang, which he campaigned against repeatedly from 958 onward, taking Chuzhou, Taizhou, Haozhou and Suzhou and pushing the line to the Huai. In the north lay Northern Han backed by Khitan support, while the Liao maintained pressure on the Youzhou line. Fighting on two fronts meant that every advance in Hebei had to be counted carefully, so Chai Rong chose to consolidate the northern frontier first and restore the lost lands afterwards rather than stake everything at once. Domestic preparation formed part of the cause as well: dredging the Bian, reorganising transport, repairing the walls, and readjusting the balance of power between the guard and the regional governors were all aimed at making an advance across the whole Hebei plain sustainable. The condition of the Liao itself also shaped events. The young emperor Muzong was incapable, affairs were largely in the hands of the Resident Commissioner of the Northern Capital and the great commanders of the north, and Xiao Siwen's caution, which avoided spending Liao cavalry before the Later Zhou main body had closed up, meant that no general battle was fought in Hebei in 958.
impact: 958年的河北接觸戰本身沒有改變南北格局，但它把959年的北伐變成了一場計畫之中的行動。張永德與郭崇在四五月間探明的遼軍部署、束城等關南據點的城防條件，以及滹沱河北岸的屯兵位置，都成為次年大軍行動的依據；後周先取束城、再取雄州、霸州，最後直指幽州的推進順序，正是沿著前一年的情報一路向前。戰略上，這次行動確立了後周對河北的攻勢樣態：不追求速決，而是以節度使的藩鎮兵為先鋒與肅清力量，以京師禁軍為戰略總預隊，逐段奪取交通與城防節點，把補給線跟著戰線一起往前推。代價同樣明顯：河北多鎮同時用兵，府庫與運輸的人力都吃緊，馬匹大量消耗，兩年之間連打南唐與遼朝，把一個剛建立的政權推到財政與軍力的極限。柴榮在959年五月兵臨幽州時病重，北伐中途停止，收復的三州十七縣未能守住，半年後他病逝，七歲的柴宗訓即位，殿前司的權力隨之膨脹，一年後陳橋兵變，宋朝代周。從河北的戰線回頭看，958年的接觸與959年的深入，是北宋統一之前最後一次大規模的河北攻略嘗試，兩宋與遼在河北南部對峙的格局，最初就是在這幾年裡被定下的。
impactEn: The limited contact fighting of 958 did not by itself change the balance between north and south, but it turned the great campaign of 959 into a planned operation. The Liao deployments, the state of the defences at Shuicheng and other points in Guannan, and the position of Xiao Siwen's garrison on the north bank of the Hutuo, all learned in April and May, became the basis of the following year's advance; the order Later Zhou kept, Shuicheng first, then Xiongzhou and Bazhou, and at last the drive on Youzhou, simply followed the previous year's intelligence step by step. Tactically, the operation set the Later Zhou pattern of attack in Hebei. No speed was sought: the troops of the regional governors served as spearhead and as the force that cleared the ground, the capital guard stayed in reserve as the strategic army, and strongpoints on roads and rivers were taken one after another with the supply line pushed forward together with the front. The cost was equally visible. Several Hebei circuits were in the field at once, the treasury and the labour of transport were strained, and horses were consumed in bulk; two campaigns in two years, against Southern Tang and then against the Liao, drove a newly founded regime to the limit of its finances and its army. Chai Rong fell ill at Youzhou in the fifth month of 959, the campaign stopped, the three prefectures and seventeen counties recovered could not be held, and he died of illness within the year. His seven-year-old Chai Zongxun succeeded him, the authority of the Palace Command grew accordingly, and the next year the Chenqiao mutiny put the Song in place of the Zhou. Viewed along the Hebei front, the contact fighting of 958 and the deeper advance of 959 were the last large attempt to conquer Hebei before the unification of the Song, and the pattern of Liao-Song confrontation across southern Hebei was set in these few years.
result: 就958年這一段來說，結果是有限而清楚的：五月成德節度使郭崇率軍攻下遼朝所占的束城，把後周的旗幟插到河北平原中段的要點上；四月張永德率鎮寧軍抵達北方邊地，就位後與成德軍形成南北呼應；遼南京留守蕭思溫的本部則始終留在滹沱河北岸，沒有與周軍主力展開決戰，也沒有放棄河北的據點。結果就是雙方在河北中線進入對峙：後周握有束城與關南一線，遼仍控制幽州、涿州、莫州與瀛州。史籍對這一戰的記載很薄，具體的接戰過程、雙方損耗與繳獲都沒有留下可信的數字，諸說並存之處只能從《資治通鑑》卷二百九十四的記載與後續年份的行動去推想。可以確定的是，這一戰是959年大北伐的前哨與練手：柴榮在兩年內先用南征消耗南唐，再用河北的兩路牽制試探遼軍，待軍政、漕運與禁軍整頓完成，才在959年揮師直指幽州。河北之戰本身沒有勝負可判，但河北這條線此後近千年都是中原與北方的交界所在，這一點它已經決定了。
resultEn: For the year 958 itself the outcome was limited but clear. In the fifth month Guo Chong, governor of Chengde, took Shuicheng from the Liao and planted the Later Zhou banner on a key point in the middle of the Hebei plain. In the fourth month Zhang Yongde had brought the Zhenning army to the northern frontier, and from that position the Zhenning and Chengde forces formed a north-south pincer. The main body under Xiao Siwen, Resident Commissioner of the Northern Capital, stayed on the north bank of the Hutuo throughout, fought no decisive action against the Zhou centre, and gave up no towns in Hebei. The result was a stand-off on the central line: Later Zhou held Shuicheng and the ground along Guannan, while the Liao kept Youzhou, Zhuo, Mo and Ying. The record of this engagement is thin. The course of the actual contact, the losses on both sides and the captures are all without reliable figures, and where the accounts differ one can only infer from the notices in the Zizhi Tongjian, juan 294, and from the actions of the years that followed. What can be established is that this was the reconnaissance and the rehearsal of the great northern campaign of 959. Chai Rong first wore down Southern Tang in the south, then probed the Liao in Hebei with two separate thrusts, and only when the army administration, the transport system and the guard had been put in order did he march in person on Youzhou. The engagement of 958 had no verdict in itself, but the line through Hebei would remain the frontier between the Central Plain and the north for close to a thousand years afterwards, and that much it had already decided.
